content: The official PHP supported versions table (checked 2026-10-03) lists PHP 8.3 security support through 2027-12-31, 8.4 active support through 2026-12-31 and security support through 2028-12-31, and 8.5 active support through 2027-12-31 and security support through 2029-12-31. Since user-selected plugin floor is 8.3+, declare 8.3 as the minimum and test all currently supported branches; recommend current actively supported PHP 8.4/8.5 for deployments, without inventing a maximum.
